purpose: Labeled clarify eval set for Feature F5. Each item = an intent + message + a mock profile (owned_products) + optional history + optional sentiment, with the ideal expect_ask. The LOAD-BEARING metric (Convention 10) is NO OVER-ASK on the resolvable buckets, tested on the HARD cases (queries that LOOK ambiguous but are resolvable from profile/history). Separate from the frozen golden set; deterministic, zero-token.
buckets_note: well_specified/profile_resolvable/history_resolvable/interaction -> expect_ask=false; truly_ambiguous -> expect_ask=true. profile_resolvable + history_resolvable are the HARD cases. not_slot = an intent that never clarifies.
